F1 [CRITICAL] Security - src/handlers/transfers.js:26
Problem: the 500 response returns `err.message` and `err.stack` to the caller.

F2 [CRITICAL] Data Integrity - src/handlers/transfers.js:10
Problem: the debit (line 10) and credit (line 16) are two separate UpdateCommand calls. If the second fails, money disappears.
